grammar.numbers: a big analogue dial: the needle sweeps to the number on a scale derived from it, the digital readout under the hub counts up (years and dates as said); a number said while the dial is taken rides as a small readout chip beside it
grammar.comparisons: classic compare panel (MotionTrack, mounted only while the cue is up; the dial dims under it)
grammar.steps: classic points panel (MotionTrack, mounted only while the cue is up; the dial dims under it)
grammar.eligibility: classic verdict cue ✓/✗ (MotionTrack, mounted only while the cue is up)
grammar.change: the dial's scale spans both values; the needle sits on the old value, then swings with a spring overshoot to the new one at swapAtMs, a ghost needle stays on the old value, the arc between them lights up and the readout counts to the new value with the direction arrow
grammar.trend: classic line graph panel (MotionTrack, mounted only while the cue is up)
grammar.lenders: logo tile on white in the readout under the hub, neutral label; a small logo chip beside the dial when the dial is taken
grammar.captionPosition: fixed dark strip under the dial, English line at the bottom of the strip

skinAxes.cover: the dial waking up (needle sweep) on the instrument panel, logo tile on white above it, title in the dark strip
skinAxes.captions: white words in the dark strip, the word being said underlined, keywords gold
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics: no footage, no presenter; the dial is the hero and holds the centre
skinAxes.transitions: the needle drops to rest and sweeps again for each number; a date turns the face into a month dial; standard chapter transitions
skinAxes.texture: dark navy brushed-metal instrument panel, metal bezel with a travelling glint, sky-to-gold scale band, pulsing gold alert lamp, screw heads
skinAxes.sound: voice + a whip on each needle swing, stat ding, chapter whoosh, cue clicks
skinAxes.cta: classic white contact card + compliance card
